answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own garden record, and its own share of the lantern quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The ledge ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1179 identities would post 3030 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
